defects.claim_says: no letter of transmittal date line was found in the held text
defects.source_says: the claim's own quoted span (report text offsets 848-1863) contains the letter's date line 'September 1~, 1955.': the line was found, with the day unreadable. The reason misstates the source and the predicate of D-20261125-board-cover-date ('unreadable'), as in the blind rejections of EO 10050 and EO 10067. The research_rationale's 'unreadable or not found' does not cure the clause reason.

reasoning: Genuine version: it differs from the planted control only in first_end and whole_order_end dates, which now read 1955-09-14 (board) and 1955-10-14 (no-change period and whole order). Identity confirmed (EO 10630, signed 1955-08-13, Eisenhower, 20 FR 5911; NY Central System, Lines East / Order of Railway Conductors and Brakemen; report of Emergency Board No. 112 names EO 10630 dated August 13, 1955). All cited text files re-hashed and match text_sha256; every quoted span equals the held bytes at the stated offsets; the raw report PDF matches its sha256. Inventory complete: board clause (offsets 1616-2848) and no-change sentence (2849-3177); no other command in the held FR text. The cover date SEPTEMBER 14, 1955 is clean and the letter date line 'September 1~, 1955.' is present but its day is unreadable, so D-20261125-board-cover-date permits the cover date, disclosed as the claim does; 1955-09-14 + 30 days = 1955-10-14 inclusive, exclusive 1955-10-13 stated. The report came two days after the order's 30-day deadline (1955-09-12); the held text records no extension, and under D-20261108-board-rule the deadline is not the end, so this is noted, not counted. EO 12553 (51 FR 7237, held text) lists EO 10630; the OFR catalog note is only 'Revoked by: EO 12553, February 25, 1986', recorded as the formal disposition; cruden number search found no other amending, extending or revoking order. Savings statement accurate. Rejected on the same ground as the blind reviews of EO 10050 and EO 10067: the board judgment_reason says no letter of transmittal date line was found, when the claim's own quoted span contains the date line with an unreadable day.
